## Outboard

Anyone want a 3.5" disk drive suitable for +D/Disciple? Slightly dodgy - works when it feels like it. It it doesn't work, tap it and it springs to life (but that's not good for your disks). I suspect there's a loose connection. You can have it for cost of post/packing from:  
G.A. MATTHEWS, 62 King Edwards Road, Barking, Essex, IG11 7TN

***

Is anyone using the RS232 on the Spectrum 128+ to drive a serial printer as I am having problems. If so ring (0568) 5348 or write to Mark Waters, 50 Westgate, Barons Cross, Leominster, Herefordshire, HR6 8SA

WANTED: Information/advice on using the Spectrum to control a MODEL RAILWAY. Contact: CHRIS CLAYTON, 21 RUDCHESTER CLOSE, CARLISLE, CA2 7XL (Carlisle 32150)

***

"FLEXIPAGE 200" for displays, exercises, adventure games, etc. A multi-use, LARGE text and graphics program for viewdata use; interactive, free-format or automatic with full demo programs and simple instructions catering for beginners to experienced users. Mainly BASIC, can be customised if desired. From £8.00 for disk, microdrive or cassette. 48K and 128K.  
S.A.E. for details: Flexibase Software, 20 The Parklands, Droitwich, Worcs, WR9 7DG

***

ZX-COMAL inclusive English manual. Structure your programs with PROC, LOOP, CASE, etc. Single key entry, 32K programmable RAM free. Normally only tape operations but info included with tips on how to use disc or microdrive. Only 135 dkr (about £12) including postage. Please use GIRO 8 56 41 91.  
Address: Leif Mortensen, Bryggervangen 29, DK-7120 Vejle 0st, Denmark. DELIVERY: 14 DAYS

***

For Sale: SPECTRUM PLUS: £40.00, 3" DD HITACHI DRIVE (Can be powered by Opus Discovery and runs in parallel with existing 3.5" drive): £24.00. Contact Harry harper, 14 Hall Lane, Walsgrave, Coventry, CV2 2AW (Tel: 0203 612812)

***

ALPHACOM PRINTER. Good condition with power supply. One and a bit rolls of thermal paper. £15 or W.H.Y... Anyone else using a (Sinclair) Spectrum 128/D'ktronic printer interface/Seikosha GP100a printer combination? The screen-dump from this set-up is terrible. Please let me know if you've solved the problem. JOHN LUBY, 38 Winterfield Gardens, DUNS, Berwickshire.

***

Automatic transfer of programs from tape to microdrive, Opus Discovery, Beta, Disciple or Plus D using SOFT-CRACK with SOFT-ROM. Better than Multiface? 525 dkr + postage (about £47). Send to Lars Jespersen, Monsgade 16a, DK-8000 Arhus C, Denmark (Tel: 06-183661) for details.
